data.what_done: Traced the child-session navigation path to see why a primary agent can appear after cycling from a subagent session.
data.approach_taken: Reviewed the session child-cycle handler and how it computes the list of sessions to navigate.
data.challenges_faced: The symptom looks like an agent mismatch but is actually a navigation target mismatch.
data.how_solved: Found moveChild includes the parent session in its cycle list, so the next step can be the parent session.
data.reasoning: Cycling siblings should not include the parent; when it does, the UI correctly shows the primary agent since it is the parent session.
next_steps: Decide whether to exclude the parent from child cycling or adjust the UI label to reflect actual behavior.
